Name: Infinite Galaxy Strength - buff or debuff Galaxy and Infinite weapons
Author: LilietBorodina
Description:
[center][b][size=5]!!!~Already existent weapons retain their stats~!!!
!!!~To apply this mod mid-save spawn in new ones~!!![/size][/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93](CJB Item Spawner be with ye)[/url]﻿[/center]

By default balanced around the Grandpa's Cane mod, so that the Galaxy Sword will be slightly better than the Copper Cane (as in my experience the Copper Cane will be available slightly earlier, money-wise, than the Galaxy Sword) and the final ultimate Cane will be just barely better than the Infinity Blade (giving incentive to buy it, but giving incentive to first finish the Infinity thing, too). Default manual values for daggers and hammers balanced around this too.

Auto-balance makes daggers have one half the stats of their respective swords, matching vanilla, and hammers have 1.2x the stats of their respective swords, approximately matching vanilla (I think CA probably eyeballed it tbh).

Uses i18n, but currently the only translation file is in English. Russian and Ukrainian coming whenever I get around to that, any other languages are up to yall.

---

Shoutout to my other combat mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32298]Happy Hunting[/url]﻿, which enables shooting over obstacles!
